node.title: KoalaBear near-positive literal inversion transport
node.closure: exact affine near-positive q-slice transport reduces 108 semantic literal cells to 42 orbits with 30 noncanonical representatives
node.statement: For every one of the twelve literal positive source-star assignments in the affine near-aligned chart w=1/c, the restricted substitutions b->1/b and (b,c,d,W)->(1/b,1/c,1/d,1/W) carry the two reconstructed q-slice residual quadratics, all twelve target allocations, and the radical named-open localizer set exactly to the printed companion assignment and target. After identifying the two orientations of the other-xi target, the 108 semantic cells form exactly 42 transport orbits. Twelve contain the already printed canonical F00 or M00 systems; the exact residual literal frontier is 30 orbit representatives. No full quotient identity, projective boundary, near-negative cell, or emptiness of those 30 representatives is asserted.
